metric_limits: Candidate counts are per detector and a row can raise several, so they do not sum to a row count; 5915 candidates cover 10245 distinct rows. conflicting_reference and notation_variant_reference were reviewed exhaustively; the other three classes were reviewed on exemplars only, so their decision counts are not a sample from which a false-positive rate can be estimated. There is no reference set of known defects, so unflagged rows are unlabeled and recall is undefined.

One hypothesis test over the 1700 prompt pairs (3400 rows) that are published exactly twice with the same reference and 8 rollouts on both copies, not a per-row detector. The test rejects independence for the population; it does not label individual rows.

Independent solution of the two conflicting-reference groups that are tractable by direct computation, covering 12 rows. The three remaining conflicting_reference groups are placeholder cases adjudicated under ER-1932eb19 and were not solved.
